subject: Encord Intro
text:
Hi [NAME],

Your name came up during a conversation we had with Steve Simoni (Founder
of Allen Control Systems) during our Physical AI event last week in SF, so
wanted to reach out to see if you'd be open to a quick chat?

We've recently started working on projects with a bunch of your unmanned
systems peers (i.e. Controp, Skydio, Airis, ACS...) to support the fine
tuning of their drone detection computer vision models with the goal of
speeding up expansion into new use cases - particularly focused on agentic
workflows to automate their annotation pipeline as their requirements grow
in complexity and scale.

Bit of context on Encord…we're a computer vision scale-up (Series B, $50M
raised) focused on consolidating data curation, annotation, and model
evaluation in one platform.

Would you be open to a quick virtual coffee with our leadership team in the
coming weeks? It'd be great to introduce ourselves & get your feedback on
what we're building. We're pretty open Friday afternoon PT, however happy
to work around your schedule!

Hi [NAME]​,

I lead the AgTech data team here at Encord (~6 years old, 100+ employees & $50M+ funding), actually working with a few of your peers (Carbon Robotics, Aigen, John Deere etc) to speed up their annotation process and improve model accuracy for image, geospatial and video training data. My team has been following AgerPoint for a while, keen to trade notes on what I've been seeing in the AgTech space & get your thoughts on what we're building if you're be open to a 30-minute chat this week or the next?

text:
